title: Gideon and the Promise
author: Cyrus Thornbury
blurb: Vesper Coldharbour, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
